title: Practice: Since, till, by, before, after, in

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я перерабатываю отходы и забочусь об окружающей ___ (среда).
exercises.prompt: I recycle and take care of the environment.
exercises.why: «об» + prepositional singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I want a unicycle for my birthday.
exercises.why: «на» + accusative singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
